name: generate_protocol
description: Generate a complete Opentrons OT-2 Python protocol script from a high-level task description. Supports serial_dilution, pcr_setup, and rt_normalization task types.

inputs.name: task_type
inputs.description: Protocol category. Must be one of: serial_dilution, pcr_setup, rt_normalization.

inputs.name: parameters_json
inputs.description: JSON string of task-specific parameters (volumes, plate counts, reagent names, etc.). See SKILL.md for per-task schemas.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: JSON string with key 'script' (the generated Python code) or 'error' on failure.
